verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for an AI coding workbench, but the evidence pack documents no public programmatic API that mirrors UI functionality. It shows only a CLI/TUI launcher, a token-protected web interface, and a plugin 'page API' for host integration. These are adjacent surfaces or developer building blocks, not an API covering everything the UI can do.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
